content.short: rarity.tools ranks generative art and collectible NFTs by rarity, enabling viewing, valuing, and comparing NFTs, with developer access to rarity rankings.
content.description: rarity.tools is a website dedicated to ranking generative art and collectible NFTs by rarity. Users can view, value, and compare NFTs using rarity-based rankings. Developers can access the rarity rankings of NFTs. Currently included NFT projects on the site are CryptoPunks, Hashmasks, Waifusion, Chubbies and Bored Ape Yacht Club.
